newsitem.title: USA: Senate Republican predicts budget amendment win.
newsitem.headline: Senate Republican predicts budget amendment win.

text.p: A member of the Senate Republican leadership predicted Tuesday that the balanced budget amendment to the Constitution would pass by a narrow margin in the Senate.
"I think we'll win by the skin of our teeth," Sen. Connie Mack of Florida, chairman of the Senate Republican Conference, told reporters.
Senate Republican Leader Trent Lott said opening statements on the balanced budget amendment would start in the Senate Wednesday afternoon.
Mack said it was expected the Senate would deal with the issue in the week starting Feb 24.
